title: The Complete Rare Drop Pack
description: Every block has a 10% chance to drop an Elytra on top of its normal drops. No commands. Just luck.
body:
# The Complete Rare Drop Pack

Every block you break has a 10% chance to hand you an Elytra. No setup, no commands - just install it and start swinging. The normal drop still happens. The Elytra is a bonus on top.

## Features
- **10% chance** to drop an Elytra from every block in the game
- **Stacks on top** of normal drops - you never lose the base drop
- **1000+ blocks** all have the bonus chance applied
- Works in survival, no cheats required

## How to use
1. Install the datapack
2. Load your world
3. Start breaking things

## Notes
- Compatible with Minecraft 26.1.2
- Pure datapack - no mods, no executables

If you make a video using this datapack, a credit or link back to this page would be appreciated!
